name: tty-resize-preserves-transcript
description: Regression: once a transcript has printed, resizing reflows it in place and never wipes it back to the banner, and leaves exactly one input frame (no stale ghost copy of the prompt from the pre-resize width). Prints /help output, then resizes and asserts the transcript survives, no banner is redrawn over it, and the prompt appears exactly once

steps.name: submit — /help prints its command list into the transcript
widen to 100 cols — transcript reflows in place, banner is NOT redrawn over it
narrow to 70 cols — transcript still present (bottom line stays visible), still no banner wipe, exactly one input frame (no ghost)
